review.reason: Domestic new retail boxed CPU, one PRODUCT. Exact AMD Ryzen 7 9700X suffix, AM5 socket, 8 cores/16 threads and integrated graphics present were reviewed against the supplied official manufacturer-source identity/specification payload and the domestic Danawa product page. Bulk, multipack, value pack and overseas variants were excluded. Catalog part number and seed identity are unchanged.
review.domesticPnReview: The domestic Danawa page explicitly separates the (정품) boxed configuration from bulk/multipack/overseas variants. Model and bundled/no-cooler specification are consistent with the manufacturer boxed PN in the catalog. The Danawa page title does not itself expose the numeric PN; identity rests on official boxed PN plus the domestic exact model and boxed packaging. Where catalog PN is null it remains null and sale SKU states model plus domestic retail BOX.
